meta.title: Receiver vault (synthetic fixture)
meta.description: SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE: a vault with separate caller / receiver / owner roles, a keeper-only allocation into a tokenized strategy, and a lending pool that is only available as an interface.

boundaries.reason: Only the interface ILendingPool is available; the implementation behind Strategy.pool is not part of the snapshot.

assumptions.text: Same token: vault.asset = strategy.asset (deployment): Both constructors receive the same token address.

notes: Synthetic fixture used by the FluxScope test-suite.
Static analysis: relations describe behaviour the code supports (candidates), not observed executions. Amounts are symbolic expressions.

checks.description: 1 entry point(s) take in USDT (example label) and issue vU (vault share) in the same transaction: Vault.enter(amount, receiver)
In Vault.enter(amount, receiver): Any account pays USDT (example label) (amount); `receiver` argument of enter() receives vU (vault share) (shares) — payer and share receiver are different parties
Vault.exit(shares, receiver, owner) burns vU (vault share) and pays out USDT (example label)

Any account calls Vault.exit(shares, receiver, owner); vU (vault share) is burned from `owner` argument of exit(); USDT (example label) is paid to `receiver` argument of exit() — shares are burned from a party other than the caller
Payout amount (amount) data-depends on the burned amount (shares)
Exit path contains 1 unresolved item(s)
